writeup: Woot has relisted Arctic Zone's Push & Pop kids lunch box combo in the Dino Skeleton design, new, at $8.99, the same price as the November 5 drop. The set includes a sandwich container, an ice pack, and a push-and-pop fidget handle. When we verified this deal earlier, Arctic Zone's own store sold the same combo (SKU 10005961) for $22.99, so this is about 60% less, a savings of about $14. Ten or more are left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
